negative_cases: Invalid saved selection, empty export, load failure, denied widget and malformed block type

acceptance_review.scope: Native parent dropdown/date selection and refresh persistence, native reload, actual CSV bytes including quotes/zero, labels/tooltips, stale saved choice UI fallback, empty-export alert, failed/denied widget isolation, separate button-action/input-Enter callbacks to a backend process step, and unsupported-block warning. Medium #554 non-parent selection persistence and #555 omitted collapse metadata are explicit limitation probes, not certified behaviors. Low #556 block input-label association is disclosed. Other block types and additional widget contracts remain in their own rows.
